svg.aria-label: What the SOCKS5 proxy carries. Through it: relay connections, with relay names resolved through the proxy, remote signers, media transfers, link previews and embedded pages, speech and translation model downloads, and telemetry exports when enabled; a failed request never falls back to a direct connection. Not through it: QUIC agent previews need UDP and are off; Marmot's HTTP host checks use local DNS; external browsers and other apps ignore it; AppImage and macOS update checks are off. So the proxy does not hide every DNS query.
